item.title: How and Why you should include jQuery from Google CDN in WP
item.description:
jQuery is a library widely used for web development, and in WordPress we have this library included in the default installation package.

In this article, I’ll show you how and why you should replace WordPress’s default jQuery with jQuery from Google CDN (Content Distribution Network).

But why should you replace it?

Generally speaking, you should do this so the script loads faster for the end user.

Here are the points that should lead you to adopt this practice.

item.title: Responsive Sites gain points in Google's rankings
item.description:
On mobile devices, research shows that 61% of visitors to a non-responsive page return to Google’s search page looking for a site that lets them view the content better.

Knowing this, the responsive web design market has been consolidating and becoming unified. Because keeping all the elements of the page’s desktop version viewable on other devices has already gone beyond an advantage and become a requirement. Mobile devices are gaining strength every day, in 2012 for every five computers sold one tablet was sold, compared with 2011, when for every fourteen computers one tablet was sold.

item.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
item.description: Through a set of techniques, methods and studies known as SEO (from the English “Search Engine Optimization”, which translates as “Otimização dos Mecanismos de Busca”), we can improve your pages’ position, in other words, when a user types a keyword into a search engine, the goal of SEO is to make one (or several) of your website’s pages appear among the first organic search results. Examples of search engines are Google, Bing and Yahoo.
